recognize_zh: 髓過氧化酶（MPO）細胞化學染色中，成熟中性球呈黃褐色陽性作為內部對照，而左側的芽細胞仍呈紫色、完全未著色（MPO 陰性），符合 AML 微分化型（M0）的 MPO 陰性芽細胞。
features: Segmented neutrophils with strong diffuse golden-brown cytoplasmic MPO reaction (internal positive control)
Blast with purple nucleus and cytoplasm lacking any brown granular reaction (MPO-negative)
Blast of moderate size with round nucleus and high N:C ratio
Background red cells with counterstain; platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained for myeloperoxidase shows segmented neutrophils with strong golden-brown cytoplasmic positivity, serving as an internal positive control. A blast in the field shows no cytoplasmic MPO reactivity. Because fewer than 3% of blasts are MPO positive in AML with minimal differentiation, a negative MPO cytochemistry with valid internal controls is expected. Findings are consistent with MPO-negative blasts; myeloid lineage must be established by flow cytometry (e.g., CD13, CD33, CD117, CD34) with exclusion of lymphoid lineage.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts are also MPO negative, so separation requires flow cytometry showing B- or T-lineage markers versus myeloid markers.
Megakaryoblasts are MPO negative but express CD41/CD61.
Monoblasts can be MPO weak or negative but show strong nonspecific esterase positivity and monocytic markers such as CD14, CD64 and CD36.
In AML with maturation, at least 3% of blasts (usually many) are MPO positive, often with Auer rods.
